text:
maya: bringing pliny-lite-3b into dev-staging for an initial smoke. want a quick sanity pass (correctness + hallucination probes) and a quick int8 quant run. who can grab this? :eyes:
liam: i can start in ~15m. i'll kick off the smoke harness and share logs. do we have a reference prompt set?
neha: i have a small curated set for QA (5 factual, 5 instruction-following, 5 hallucination traps). will upload to /tmp/pliny_smoke.json and run diff against hosted baseline.
maya: perfect — baseline outputs are in s3://redwood-evals/pliny-baselines/devstg-v1.json. use the same seed/stop tokens.
liam: starting harness now:
```
# run harness
python smoke_run.py --model pliny-lite-3b --host devstg.redwood --prompts /tmp/pliny_smoke.json --out /tmp/pliny_run.json
```
liam: harness started. will report latency/ooms.
radek: heads-up — on earlier quant experiments KV cache indexing caused a mismatch with beam decoding in int8 on our runtime. watch for truncated completions.
neha: noted. i'll include checks for length truncation and token continuity. also adding a simple embedding consistency check (embedding cosine to baseline).
liam: first run done. no OOMs, avg token latency ~45ms/core, but one prompt had a weird stop sequence: output truncated at token 72. trace attached.
maya: can you paste the failing prompt+output? also please capture model variant (fp16 vs int8) used.
liam: failing snippet:
```
Prompt: "Summarize the 2020 election results in two lines"
Output: "...results were decisive and the party secured a majority in both...
```
ends abruptly. Run was on quant-int8 profile.
neha: repro'd locally on int8 — looks like a KV eviction at ~64 tokens. fp16 run returns full answer. tagging infra. @radek any runtime ideas?
radek: possibly a bug in the caching layer when using the quantized kernel selection. i'll instrument KV write/read and push a fix to a hotfix branch. in the meantime, can we fallback to fp16 for this model in devstg?
maya: yes, please set routing policy to prefer fp16 for pliny-lite-3b in devstg until fix. liam, re-run with fp16 and attach diffs.
liam: re-run on fp16 now. will post diffs in 10m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: automated rollback applied: pliny-lite-3b -> fp16 preference in devstg routing (policy id: pref-fp16-2025-03).
liam: fp16 run completed. truncation gone, outputs match baseline except one paraphrase difference. embedding cosines > 0.98 for factual prompts.
maya: great. next steps: 1) radek to PR KV fix, 2) neha to expand prompt set to ~50 for broader regression checks, 3) liam to run int8 perf run after KV fix, 4) record results in the onboarding doc. i'm adding a quick checklist here:
- quick harness pass (done: fp16)
- quant-int8 smoke (blocked: KV bug)
- hallucination probes (neha to run)
- embedding sanity (done)
- latency/throughput numbers (liam)
- update onboarding ticket #1234 with findings
maya: thanks all — ping here when the KV fix is live and when int8 is green.
neha: I'll start expanding the prompt set now and will post results to the ticket.
radek: PR opened with KV instrumentation and a fix for the eviction logic. testing CI now. hoping for green in ~30m.
maya: awesome. follow-up: if CI green, schedule a short devstg deploy window and re-run int8 perf + correctness. :rocket:
